content: Hapatpat
Re wol bisiy, fedmal chog hami mele yebe mmal le rebe mel bo chol foloy. Hami ngo ha gola le hamem ika hasa mel bo chol foloy, ila Deus yebe halimchigi tot yal hatugulu kofmem mo imor sibis.
Pangach yarmat ngo sima machey. Iwe ngo hare semal le ye tema machey irel mekla yema kapta, ila ngo tor hapagol, ngo yebe wol yoh ngali le be iy chog yal haffaliy kofal llufulyal.
Sima hapanggiy sew mityel parang le yor yol lal yewal semal wos bo ila ngo yebe loh lobosle si dipli yebe loh iyang.
Ha luluwaley seyay barko. Heramo ye palleng ngo ye loloh luwul mmorol yaeng mo hatobtob, ngo halsew mityel fadol mele ye kekawele sa loloh lobola kapin we ye luluwaley be loh iyang.
Ila sengal mele yewach yarmat. Ye wechich ngo yema habos irel yal ma kapta hapatpat kala ye palleng. Habe luluwaley le sew mityel yaef ngo be yoh le yebe fisgaloh sew fuluy.

Mele yewach yarmat ila ye wochog sew yaef. Meka yewach ila madpil meka holngoch, ngo yal taiykof ila be yoh le yebe hatayikofagich. Yaef la yebe hasidoh mo Infiyerno, ila be yoh le yebe fisgaloh igegel yach memel.
Ye mmal ngal yarmat le rebe hafigerar pangal mael kala foruyel Deus: mael machoh, mael yeyal, mael kala rema mel wolfulu, ngo re wol ma mel leted mo yig.

Iwe ngo tor semal le ye yoh le yebe hafigra meka yewach yarmat. Mele ila sew tayikof le towe yoh sibe holu kofal. Iwe ngo yebe yoh le yebe lilimesloh yarmat, le be wochog semal parchoyoh kowe ye poison.
Sima tapeli meka yewach sibe kangalu Deus la Temach yal hachigchig. Iwe ngo sima wol tapeli sibe hapatpat tayikof irer rechokla Deus ye hasburdoh le re igegel iy Deus.
Hapatpat ka ye momay mo ika ye tayikof ila yema buyoy chog mo lal meka yewach yarmat. Re wol bisiy, mele ila towe iye sengal.
Tor sew chael le ha bela yid mo iyang le yebe lloay ngo ye wol merat.

Re wol bisiy, tor sehay fig le bela buyoy uwal ngo ye bele uwal olives. Towe yoh le yebe buyo grape sala mel bo uwal fig, ngo towe wol yoh le yebe budoh chael ka ye lloay mo irel sew chael le ye taed.
Repiy La Ye Bidiy Mo Wol Laeng
Yor semal mo luwulumi le ye teram ngo ye medaf lal depal? Semal le iy ngo yebe hallehaloh mo irel momayel yal wegdeg luwul malulu mo repiy.
Ngo hare lal mekla dipmi ila ye ssogol loltemay, mo luwalel chog holongmi llufulumi mo ssong, ila ngo ha towe foru bo habe molfid irel yami kachepar bo ha repiy.
Tappel repiy le ila yete bidiy mo wol laeng. Ye budoh mo wol talople iwe ngo te yael Espritu Santus, bo yael moniyan.
Solbos le yebe yor loltemay iyang ngo yarmat rema luluwaley chog kofer lufulyer, ila yebe wol yor taroprop mo pangal metmetael tayikof iyang.
Iwe ngo repiy la ye bidiy mo wol laeng ila tor derel. Ye pos, ngo ye malulu, ngo ye hakola, ngo ye ssogol ffaho mo wegdeg momay.
Ngo momay ila uwal milay kala rechokla rema hasidoh hopos rema fedagu luwul hopos.
